Top-down concept for a tactical game. ONE creature, the SPITTER: the Rav Bloom swarm's fragile ranged strain (Starsector mod: Marines against an engineered biological weapon). BODY AND FIRING: A heavy, hunched, round-backed biped: a huge domed back like a shell over a short body, short powerful legs, head held low and forward. Three short vents on the crown of the dome; it lowers its head, braces, and fires the glob up from the dome vents.

Strict overhead orthographic view, camera looking straight down at its back, standing at rest, facing UP (head toward the top), centred, filling about two thirds of the frame, light from the upper left. Plain flat light grey background (#b4b4b4), no shadow, no ground, no projectile, no text, no border.
